fullDescription:
Create a complete Next.js React TypeScript component called "InsidePOV 3D Video Carousel" with the following specifications: CORE DESIGN: - Inside perspective 3D video carousel where user stands at center looking outward at videos arranged on a large outer circle - NOT a typical ring carousel with cards overlapping in center - completely different POV - PC display: exactly 7 visible cards (center 1 + left 3 + right 3) - Central card appears farthest/smallest/deepest - Left/right outer cards appear closer/larger/in foreground - Cinematic tunnel-like perspective with converging depth TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS: - Next.js App Router with "use client" directive - React + TypeScript with CSS Modules - No external animation libraries (no framer-motion, GSAP, jQuery) - CSS 3D transforms with preserve-3d CSS STRUCTURE (InsidePovCarousel.module.css): .carousel with CSS variables: --pov-perspective: 1200px (PC) --pov-radius: 640px --pov-card-w: 220px --pov-card-h: 390px --pov-step: 25.714285deg (360/14) --pov-rotation: 0deg --pov-tilt-x: 0deg --pov-card-radius: 18px .stage with perspective and preserve-3d .world with rotateY and rotateX transforms .card positioned absolute at center, using: transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotateY(calc(var(--i) * var(--pov-step))) translateZ(calc(var(--pov-radius) * -1)) Key: translateZ is NEGATIVE (-radius) to place cards outside/behind viewpoint CARD STYLING: - Rounded corners (18px) - Subtle shadows and inner light effects - Backface-visibility hidden - Glass-like overlays with gradients - Video fills card with object-fit: cover INTERACTIVITY: - requestAnimationFrame-based auto-rotation (0.04 deg/frame) - Pointer drag interaction (0.28 sensitivity) - Inertia momentum (0.94 friction) - Hover pauses auto-rotation - Touch/swipe support with touch-action: none - Keyboard: Arrow keys for manual rotation, Space to toggle autoRotate VISIBILITY: - Video cards ONLY displayed - NO UI buttons, controls, or labels - NO Previous/Next buttons - NO Play/Pause button - NO center marker dot - NO field-of-view guide lines - NO outer circle guides - NO drag/swipe instruction text - NO hint text of any kind - Clean minimalist display COMPONENT PROPS: type VideoItem = { src: string; poster?: string; alt?: string } type InsidePovCarouselProps = { videos: VideoItem[]; autoRotate?: boolean (default true); interactive?: boolean (default true); className?: string; } HTML STRUCTURE:

DEPTH PERCEPTION: - Center card: smallest scale, most faded brightness, feels deepest - Adjacent cards: medium scale, normal opacity - Outer visible cards: largest scale, brightest - All connected naturally via 3D perspective math - No jarring pop-in effects BACKGROUND: - Subtle radial gradient from light center to slightly darker edges - Soft directional lighting effect - Overall warm neutral tone (beige/cream) - Inset and drop shadows for subtle dimension RESPONSIVE: - Mobile (max-width: 760px): --pov-perspective: 760px --pov-radius: 420px --pov-card-w: 156px --pov-card-h: 278px --pov-step: 25.714285deg (same, 14 cards) ANIMATION: - No CSS animation - use requestAnimationFrame - Manual drag: update rotation on pointermove - Momentum: apply velocity decay after pointerup - Auto-rotate: continuous +0.04 per frame when enabled - Smooth variable updates via CSS custom properties BROWSER COMPAT: - Modern browsers with CSS 3D support - Graceful fallback for reduced-motion - Touch event handling with pointerEvents API - Backface-visibility for performance EXAMPLE USAGE (app/page.tsx): import InsidePovCarousel from "@/components/InsidePovCarousel"; const videos = Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => ({ src: `/videos/demo-${i + 1}.mp4`, poster: `/videos/poster-${i + 1}.jpg`, alt: `Video ${i + 1}` })); export default function Page() { return (
